title: Kintaq language
description: Austroasiatic language spoken in Malaysia and Thailand
extract: Kintaq, or Kentaq Bong, is an Austroasiatic language spoken in Malaysia and Thailand. It belongs to the Northern Aslian sub-branch of the Aslian languages. The small number of speakers is decreasing.
